items.description:
LuxLiv Property Group is an estate agency that focuses on Centurion's golf-estate communities, marketing homes across Centurion Golf Estate, Blue Valley Golf Estate and Copperleaf Golf & Country Estate. The agency handles sales, rentals and market valuations, and lists property across residential types from apartments and townhouses to full freehold homes, as well as commercial and agricultural land.

Its video home tours have built a following online, passing seven million views, giving buyers a close look at listings before viewing them in person. Based on Jean Avenue in Centurion Golf Estate, the agency works with buyers and sellers looking for the lifestyle and security of estate living in and around Centurion.

Lyttelton Firearm Training Centre forms part of Ballistic Training Academy, trading as Centurion Indoor Shooting, and is a fully accredited institution with both the Professional Firearms Trainers Council (PFTC) and the South African Police Service. It offers the proficiency training legally required before an applicant can apply for a SAPS competency certificate, covering handguns, shotguns, and manually operated and self-loading rifles and carbines, for both personal and business-purposes licensing.

Training also covers the legal test on the Firearms Control Act, Regulation 21 compliance testing, and renewal of business-purposes competency certificates. Based on Jean Avenue in Lyttelton, Centurion, the centre serves individuals and businesses working through South Africa's firearm licensing process from first application to ongoing compliance.

MacBuild Clubview is a hardware store built around seven departments covering building materials, paint and accessories, plumbing supplies, electrical, doors and windows, tools and hardware, and gardening. The Clubview Centre branch stocks sand, stone, cement, bricks, timber and other daily-delivery items, and its team gives practical advice to homeowners, businesses and contractors working through DIY jobs and full building projects.

With more than a decade of hardware experience, MacBuild sources its products from trusted manufacturers and suppliers and takes a considered approach to energy-efficient products and waste reduction. The Clubview Centre branch in Centurion operates alongside a second MacBuild store in Raslouw, giving customers across the area a nearby option for building and renovation supplies.

MAD IT TECH takes a business-first approach to technology, starting by understanding a client's actual problem before recommending a solution. Its services span IT and business consulting, IT procurement and infrastructure, business process solutions that simplify workflows, and digital services including websites, online services and webinars for clients across Rietvalleirand and the wider Pretoria area.

The team works through a three-step approach: understanding what a business is trying to achieve, analysing its people, processes and systems, and only then recommending the technology that fits. This client-focused, process-driven approach suits businesses that want practical IT and digital solutions matched to how they actually operate, rather than technology for its own sake.

Magate Phala and Associates is a labour law firm based in Midstream Estate, Centurion, specialising in labour and employment law. Its services cover chairing and initiating disciplinary and appeal hearings, alternative dispute resolution through mediation and arbitration, and broader legal consulting for employers and employees navigating workplace disputes.

The firm keeps a visible presence in the profession, including attending the South African Society for Labour Law's annual national conference, and has built a following of more than 30,000 on social media. Operating from Midlands Office Park West on Mount Quray Road, it serves businesses and individuals across Centurion and the wider Pretoria area needing representation or guidance in labour-related matters.

Mahumani Incorporated is a law firm offering attorney, notary and conveyancing services from offices across Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Johannesburg and Polokwane. Its notarial work covers the certification and notarisation of contracts, apostilles and antenuptial agreements, while its conveyancing team handles property transactions from drafting through to final registration, guided by a deep understanding of South African property law.

The firm also runs a correspondence office network and takes part in social responsibility initiatives alongside its core legal practice. From its Muckleneuk offices at Walker Creek Office Park, it combines litigation support with everyday conveyancing, notarial and commercial work for individuals and businesses across the regions it serves.

Major Cycle City Villieria is a family-oriented bicycle retailer specialising in mountain bikes and cycling equipment for recreational riders of all ages. The workshop handles bicycle repairs and servicing, including derailleur replacements, wheel balancing and brake and gear work using Shimano components, alongside bicycle upgrades, helmets and accessories for everyday and trail riding. The store also buys and sells new and second-hand bicycles, giving customers an affordable way in or out of the sport.

Operating from the corner of Nico Smith Street and 30th Avenue in Villieria, with a second branch in Les Marais, the business ships bicycles nationwide for customers outside Pretoria. Its focus on making cycling accessible for families to spend active time together, rather than just competitive riders, suits parents looking to get children started on two wheels as much as experienced mountain bikers needing a service or upgrade.

makota attorneys is a law firm registered with the Law Society of Northern Provinces and holding a Fidelity Fund Certificate under the Attorneys Act. Established in 2013, the firm built its early reputation in criminal law and general civil litigation, and its services have since grown to include commercial law, third-party and personal injury claims, immigration matters, and estate and trust work.

The firm positions itself around sensitivity to difficult matters, availability to clients and a fast turnaround time, aiming to provide cost-effective legal services without compromising on quality. Based in Riviera, Pretoria, it serves both existing and prospective clients across these practice areas from its North Pretoria offices.

Marvellous Maids Pretoria has operated since 1997 and is now part of a network of more than 60 sites stretching from KwaZulu-Natal and Mpumalanga to the North West, Eastern and Western Cape and Gauteng. Staff are selected and vetted around what the company calls its H.A.R.P standard — honesty, attitude, reliability and punctuality — and are uniformed and placed under its Integrity Policy before being sent to a home or business.

Beyond regular domestic and commercial cleaning, the Salieshoek-based team also offers permanent domestic worker placements, rental property management, pest control, and elderly and frail care, alongside once-off cleans and Airbnb turnarounds, and is open Monday to Friday from 7am to 5pm and Saturdays until 1pm.

Mbatha Africa Holdings delivers construction, engineering and project services across the public and private sectors from its base in Olievenhoutbosch. In ten years of operation the company has completed more than 100 projects and assignments, covering new building construction, remodelling and renovations, carpentry such as deck construction, fitted cupboards and stair framing, and painting work including waterproofing, damp-proofing and roof painting.

The company also runs a civil building services division handling feasibility studies, drainage and floodplain studies, site development plans and land surveying, together with an interior design arm covering space planning and custom office, commercial and residential interiors. This combination of trades under one roof suits clients needing a single contractor across both structural and finishing stages of a project in Centurion.

MBG Media is a full-service digital agency operating from Derdepoort Smallholdings in Silverton, Pretoria, with more than ten years of experience across web design, graphic design, branding, photography and videography. Recent projects include the website for Equate Africa, an independent property and construction consultancy, graphic design work for the Lakeside Lifestyle Estate in Gauteng, and app development for a carp-fishing companion app and an earthmoving equipment hire directory.

The agency positions itself as a single point of contact for businesses that need their online presence, branding and marketing materials handled together rather than through separate suppliers, and its portfolio spans property, lifestyle, tourism and app-based clients.

MD Mitchell Attorneys Inc is a Centurion law firm built around property law, handling property transfers, conveyancing and notarial practice for clients across the area. The practice is led by a High Court attorney who also holds appointment as a conveyancer and notary public, giving the firm the standing to handle the full registration process for property transactions from start to finish. Other staff at the practice are themselves admitted High Court attorneys, assisting clients through the transfer and bond-registration process alongside the firm's notarial work.

Based at 250 End Street in Clubview, Centurion, the firm has built its practice around property transactions specifically, rather than general litigation, giving clients a dedicated point of contact for buying, selling or registering property in and around Centurion. This focus suits homeowners, buyers and sellers needing a straightforward, experienced conveyancing service close to home.

Medical Solutions MSG supplies, calibrates, services and repairs occupational health and medical equipment, working on-site and in-house for clients across South Africa. Its product range includes the MSG 3L Volume Calibration Syringe for bi-directional testing of spirometry devices, the MSG USB Weather Station for measuring pressure, temperature and humidity, and the MSG Vision Screener, a portable unit for rapid vision tests that can be used manually or alongside the company's own software.

That software, OccuPlus, is a single-entry occupational health system that generates certificates of fitness and Annexure 3 documentation, backs up data automatically and can brand medical certificates with anti-fraud verification. Medical Solutions MSG operates from Rietondale, Pretoria, and a second site in Woodstock, Cape Town, seeing clients by appointment only.

Mega Paints and Hardware Lyttelton is a hardware and paint shop in Lyttelton Commercial Park on Botha Avenue, Lyttelton Manor, stocking tools, building supplies and a full range of paints. The shop has built a strong local reputation, with 15 of its 16 customer reviews rating it five stars for service and product quality.

Shopping is designed to be straightforward: the store offers delivery for off-site orders, easy in-store pickup, and accepts credit cards, while a wheelchair-accessible entrance and car park make it accessible to all customers. It serves DIY enthusiasts, tradespeople and homeowners across Centurion's Lyttelton Manor area looking for paint and general hardware supplies close to home.

Menlyn Mix Business Hub is an apart-hotel in Lynnwood Glen built around business travellers who need both a productive workspace and a place to unwind during an extended stay. Its on-site business hub and meeting rooms offer high-speed internet access, and the property maintains backup power and water tanks to keep guests running through outages and water interruptions.

Beyond the workspace, guests have access to a temperature-controlled swimming pool, rooftop garden, rooftop adventure golf, a rooftop yoga area and a clubhouse with chill-out zones, plus family-friendly facilities for guests travelling with children. Located near Menlyn Maine at the corner of Kelvin Street and Jocelyn Road, it combines corporate convenience with leisure amenities for longer stays in Pretoria.

Metrofile Pretoria provides records and information management services, including secure physical records storage, document scanning and digitisation, active filing, and confidential destruction of documents no longer needed. Its records solutions extend to secure warehouses and data vaults with indexing, retrieval and tracking systems, so client documents can be stored, found and recovered on request rather than simply archived and forgotten.

Beyond physical records, the branch offers cloud services, business-process automation and information advisory services, helping clients manage records across both paper and digital formats. Metrofile has more than four decades of experience in records management and storage, operating across South Africa and several international markets, and this Pretoria branch trades from Old Mutual Roseville Park at the corner of Moot Street and E'skia Mphahlele Drive in Roseville. It serves businesses across the region needing secure, searchable storage for their records rather than an in-house archive.

MFB Consultants is an accounting firm offering financial and accounting services to businesses of all sizes, with a team experienced in tax planning, bookkeeping and financial reporting. The practice is built around personalised service, aiming to give clients the information and advice they need to make informed financial decisions, and helps with everything from day-to-day bookkeeping and tax preparation through to full financial reporting and business guidance.

Beyond its Muckleneuk office at Optiplan House in Brooklyn, Pretoria, MFB Consultants also operates branches in Sunninghill, Gauteng, and Rustenburg in the North West, giving the practice a footprint across two provinces. This spread lets the firm support clients who need consistent, accessible accounting and tax guidance whether their business is based in Gauteng or further afield in the North West.

Minit Print Pretoria North has traded since 1996 as an independently owned outlet of the Minit Print Group, a franchise network whose first store opened more than four decades ago. The outlet handles traditional litho printing, from single spot-colour runs to full-colour work with a fifth overprint colour and coating in a single pass, alongside its over-the-counter copy shop and print-on-demand services.

Finishing options include foiling, embossing, UV varnishing, thermal lamination and die-cutting, and the outlet is one of only three printing companies in South Africa to have invested in Scodix digital embossing technology, which adds raised, textured finishes to printed pieces. Based in Pretoria North, it serves customers needing business cards through to large commercial print runs with fast turnaround.

Minuteman Press Silverton relocated to the Six Fountains Adventure Centre in December 2018 and reopened on 9 January 2019, trading from a shop next to Volvo Silver Lakes on the corner of Solomon Mahlangu Drive and Bendeman Boulevard in Pretoria East. The move brought a new showroom alongside the same printing team and service that customers in the area already knew.

The shop's print range covers business cards, custom stamps, flyers, menus, postcards, brochures, labels and magnets, stationery, calendars, forms and blueprints, along with presentation folders and other promotional products. This breadth lets Pretoria East businesses get most of their printed marketing and office materials produced through a single local supplier.

Montani Property Valuers (Pty) Ltd has provided professional property valuation services from Annlin, Pretoria, since it was established in 2012. The practice covers market valuations, rental valuations and rental reviews, investment-property valuations and insurance valuations, as well as more specialised work such as municipal valuations, land restitution valuations, expropriation valuations, and valuations for liquidation, insolvency and deceased estates.

The practice is led by a valuer registered with the South African Council for the Property Valuers Profession and an associate member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors, giving clients access to valuation work recognised to both local and international professional standards. Operating from Dolphin Park in Rooiwal, Montani Property Valuers serves homeowners, investors, attorneys and institutions across Pretoria needing an accredited valuation for a sale, dispute, estate or statutory purpose.

items.description:
Mphahlele & Masipa Inc. Attorneys is a boutique law firm established in 2016, offering legal and advisory services to commercial clients and private individuals from offices in Johannesburg and Pretoria. Its practice areas span Road Accident Fund matters, family law, general civil law and commercial law, along with litigation support for clients working through disputes in these areas.

The firm has appeared as attorneys of record in South African High Court proceedings and features on government legal-services panels, independent evidence that the practice is active beyond its own marketing. From its Pretoria office on Florence Ribeiro Avenue in Lukasrand, the firm serves businesses and individuals across the city needing representation in RAF claims, family matters, civil disputes or commercial legal work.

Mventech is a mining engineering and business-improvement firm based in Southdowns Office Park, Centurion, working across environmental, mechanical and energy engineering disciplines. Its team of engineers, modellers and strategists has delivered projects spanning base metals, precious metals and coal, contributing more than 40 professional publications and work valued at over R30 billion across four continents.

Beyond engineering design, the firm runs mining excellence and business-improvement programmes, along with turnkey and project services covering operational readiness and project execution, delivered using an agile approach. Mventech works with mining clients from its Centurion base, applying specialised research and development skills to improve safety, efficiency and business processes.

items.description:
NEASA, the National Employers Association of South Africa, was the first employers' association registered under the Labour Relations Act of 1995 and represents member businesses on labour law and industrial relations matters, including representation in the Labour Court. Its support extends to Employment Equity and B-BBEE solutions, skills and youth development programmes, payroll guidance, tax risk insurance and Compensation Fund matters.

Members can reach the association's labour law experts through a 24-hour national hotline for urgent workplace issues. Based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, NEASA positions itself as an industrial-relations specialist for employers across South Africa, covering the full range of statutory and labour-related compliance obligations businesses face.

Nefuri Attorneys Inc is a Florauna-based law firm handling divorce matters, human rights and HR-related legal issues, personal injury claims and Road Accident Fund claims for clients across Pretoria North. The practice keeps clients informed through a dedicated news section on its site, alongside a straightforward enquiry and consultation process for people dealing with sensitive legal matters.

Based on Nunanda Street in Florauna, the firm serves individuals needing support with family law, workplace-related disputes, or accident and injury claims, offering a single point of contact for these personal legal matters in the northern part of Pretoria. Clients can reach the practice directly to discuss a case before moving forward with instructions.

items.reason: Insufficient reliable current information found to independently verify the computer and television repair services: the own site was blocked by an anti-bot challenge in this crawl, and search results were entirely irrelevant (football live-score sites).

items.description:
NETCB ZA delivers IT infrastructure and cybersecurity solutions, with services spanning technical support, digital workspaces, hybrid cloud, backup and disaster recovery, and legal compliance. The company also distributes open-source technology, positioning itself as a specialist in deploying open-source solutions that streamline operations and strengthen security within client IT environments.

Among its own developed tools are a GroupWise video conferencing add-on, data migration tools and the HybridRMS records-management system. Operating from the Innovation Hub at Persequor in Pretoria, NETCB ZA works with businesses needing end-to-end consulting, implementation and ongoing support across infrastructure, cybersecurity and software, aiming to reduce risk and support continuity for clients across the region.

Nomfundo Exploration and Consulting is a 100% black-owned geological, geophysical and civil engineering consultancy based in Riviera, Pretoria. The firm is a Level 3 B-BBEE contributor with 100 BEE points and 110% B-BEE recognised procurement, and its geotechnical team carries out site investigations in line with published national guidelines for engineering projects.

Its geophysical division works with external geologists on sub-surface surveys, including seismic work, while its engineering geology and civil engineering services cover water resource and environmental assessments alongside infrastructure development, design and project management. The practice serves clients needing geotechnical, geophysical or civil engineering input for construction, infrastructure and resource projects across the region.

The North Gauteng Association of Advocates was founded on 30 November 2012 by members of the Pretoria branch of the National Forum of Advocates who had become estranged from that body's Johannesburg head office. Most of its founding members had previously belonged to the Pretoria Society of Advocates and had passed the Bar Examination of the General Council of the Bar.

The association currently has 24 full members and two associate members, with experience ranging from one to 40 years at the Bar, and it maintains court roll information covering day rolls, family matters, opposed and unopposed motions, settlement rolls and urgent court rolls. Based in Rietondale, Pretoria, it supports its members' day-to-day practice before the North Gauteng courts.

Nova Dental Care provides general and cosmetic dentistry from the first floor of Southlake Centre on Lenchen Avenue North in Centurion, above Jam Clothing and opposite Centurion Mall and BCX. Treatments on offer range from everyday care such as white fillings, crowns, dentures and fissure sealants to cosmetic work including veneers, teeth whitening and anti-wrinkle treatment.

The practice also provides dental implants, night guards and short-term orthodontics for patients wanting straighter teeth without a lengthy treatment plan. Its central, mall-adjacent location makes it a convenient option for Centurion residents seeking a single dental practice for both routine check-ups and cosmetic smile improvements.

Novicus Systems has provided business IT services across Pretoria since 2004, covering everything from desktops and notebooks to full server solutions, virtualisation and data-centre support. Its managed IT support includes remote and on-site assistance, proactive monitoring, help-desk ticketing and asset management, aimed at keeping everyday business technology running without surprises.

The company also handles cloud solutions such as Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online, hybrid backup and virtual servers, alongside web hosting, web design, email security and filtering, and business connectivity services. This range lets Novicus Systems act as a single IT partner for Pretoria businesses, combining hands-on support with longer-term infrastructure and cloud projects.

items.description:
OK Foods Trios is a Shoprite Checkers-owned grocery store in Jan Niemand Park operating under the OK Grocer banner, with departments covering fresh fruit and vegetables, a bakery, a butchery, a deli counter and a full liquor section. Shoppers can join the store's loyalty programme to save on purchases and take part in promotional prizes run through its social media channels.

The store is wheelchair accessible and offers both curbside pickup and home delivery alongside regular in-store shopping, keeping extended trading hours from 5am to 8:30pm Monday to Saturday, and 6am to 8pm on Sundays. It serves residents across Jan Niemand Park and the surrounding Pretoria West area looking for a full grocery and liquor shop close to home.

One Percent SA (PTY) Ltd. is an accounting and bookkeeping firm charging a single fee set at 1% of a client's monthly business turnover, rather than hourly rates and separate retainers. That fee covers monthly bookkeeping, VAT201 submissions with annual VAT reconciliation, monthly PAYE submissions and reconciliation, provisional tax returns, payroll for up to 10 employees, annual company tax returns and annual financial statements, with a minimum package fee of R79 per month.

The firm also runs an online tax store where individuals can buy specific registration or tax services, such as personal income tax membership, with its SARS-registered team handling CIPC, SARS and CSD administration and confirming completion within 24 hours. Operating from Spaces business centres including its Waterkloof Glen office, One Percent SA serves clients needing straightforward, turnover-based accounting support across South Africa.

Online Intelligence was established as a partnership in 2001 and incorporated as Online Intelligence (Pty) Ltd in 2003, growing into a market-leading provider of enterprise risk, security management, and incident and investigative case management software. Its CiiMS platform includes modules such as CiiMS Risk for threat identification and mitigation, CiiMS Intel, CiiMS Ops, Signal Tower and CiiMS ReportIT, alongside event and alarm monitoring capabilities.

The company's software is applied across investigative case management, physical security management, mining security and investigations, fraud management, campus management, estate management, and health and safety. From its head office in The Willows, Pretoria, Online Intelligence supports organisations needing an integrated, configurable system to manage risk and security across these environments.

Oxford Office Park operates under The Success Academy's office-leasing brand, offering business park offices in Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, to companies of varying sizes. Prospective tenants can arrange a personalised tour of the premises before committing to a lease, giving them a first-hand look at the facilities and working environment on offer.

The park is supported by a national call centre for enquiries and dedicated rental and marketing contacts for day-to-day tenant support. Located in Building 1 at Oxford Business Park on Bauhinia Street, it gives businesses in the Highveld Techno Park area a managed office environment with ongoing landlord support.

Pamphlet Experts has been distributing pamphlets, flyers and other printed marketing material door-to-door across Pretoria since 1994, building a reputation as one of the region's foremost independent distributors. Its hands-on, supervised control systems and close personal involvement in each campaign are aimed at ensuring materials reach their intended audience reliably, across more than 150 suburbs in and around the city.

Beyond distribution, the company's in-house team handles graphic design and precision printing, letting clients develop a campaign from concept through to delivery with one supplier. Based in Doornpoort, Pamphlet Experts is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays until 1pm, serving businesses across Pretoria that need door-to-door marketing reach.

PG Aluminium Tshwane manufactures and installs architectural aluminium windows, doors, frameless products and smart glass for residential and commercial buildings from its Waltloo base. Each window and door is custom made to the client's specifications using quality aluminium and glass, with the company handling every phase of a project from design through manufacture to final inspection.

The business also runs an online shop for aluminium products alongside its made-to-order residential and commercial installation work, and provides detailed quotations before any project begins. Serving homeowners and commercial clients across Pretoria, PG Aluminium Tshwane positions its service around personal attention rather than mass-produced, off-the-shelf options.

items.description:
PiLog Systems (Pty) Ltd provides enterprise master-data management, data-quality and data-governance solutions built for asset-intensive industries such as mining, oil and gas, and other industrial sectors. Its services cover data-quality management, data governance and data migration, alongside inventory optimisation, asset lifecycle management, supply-chain management and spend analytics, supported by SAP implementation services and its own AI-driven PiLog DQG Suite.

With 30 years of master-data experience, PiLog has built a client base of more than 300 customers worldwide and completed over 300 SAP-certified integrations, giving it a track record across a wide range of industrial and enterprise environments. The company is based at PiLog Building 5 in Centurion Gate, Zwartkop, and works with asset-intensive businesses needing accurate, well-governed data to run their operations and SAP systems effectively.

Planet Fitness MegaClub is a large-format fitness club offering a full range of gym facilities, including cardio and resistance training equipment, group exercise classes and personal-training options for members at different stages of their fitness journey. As one of Planet Fitness's MegaClub-tier facilities, it carries a larger footprint and broader equipment range than the brand's standard clubs, giving members more space and variety to train in.

The club trades from 130 Akkerboom Street, on the corner of Akkerboom Shopping Centre and John Vorster Drive in Zwartkop, Centurion, and is open from 4:30am to 9pm on weekdays, 4:30am to 8pm on Fridays, 7am to 6pm on Saturdays and 7am to 4pm on Sundays. This extended schedule suits members fitting workouts in before work, after hours or over weekends in the Centurion area.

PNA Raslouw is a branch of the PNA stationery and arts-and-crafts chain, stocking a full range of stationery, school supplies, office products, art materials and craft supplies for shoppers across Centurion. The store gives customers a single stop for everyday stationery needs alongside more specialised art and craft materials, serving students, offices, teachers and hobbyists shopping for supplies in one visit.

The branch trades from Shop 4 at Raslouw Lifestyle Centre, on Hendrik Verwoerd Drive in Raslouw, Centurion, a location confirmed independently through both PNA's own store locator and the shopping centre's own tenant directory. It is open from 8am to 7pm on weekdays, 8am to 6pm on Saturdays and 8am to 5pm on Sundays, giving shoppers in the area a convenient stationery and craft option most days of the week.

PostNet Eastwood Village is an independently owned PostNet franchise trading from Eastwood Village Shopping Centre on the corner of Eastwood and Pretorius Street in Arcadia. The store's print and copy services cover A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing, name badges and rubber stamps, alongside convenience stationery and packaging materials for walk-in customers.

It also handles courier bookings and offers Vox website services, giving Arcadia-based individuals and small businesses a local stop for printing, packaging and sending parcels. As an independently owned branch within the national PostNet network, it combines franchise-backed systems with the responsiveness of a locally run store.

items.description:
Prinsloos Attorneys is a niche law firm in Riviera, Pretoria, specialising in insurance and liability law, including insurance litigation, road-engineering liability, municipal liability, agricultural liability, retail liability and medical negligence. Its client base includes two of the world's largest insurers, Africa's largest retailer and South Africa's largest hospital group, and the firm is entrusted by 13 South African insurers as well as three UK firms and their clients.

Describing itself as a modern practice built on old-school values, the firm also represents individual claimants alongside its large corporate clients, aiming to limit risk through effective litigation management rather than simply reacting to claims as they arise. Its approach rates success by how well it manages a client's exposure to litigation risk while keeping costs proportionate to value delivered.

ProDiS (Pty) Ltd is a value-added distributor of Mobotix industrial IP surveillance equipment, built around hemispheric and decentralised camera technology that the company says produces more revealing, stronger-evidence images than other camera formats. Beyond cameras, the company supplies supporting networking equipment, storage, optical and mobility products, automation and analytics tools, and full Integrated Video Management Systems, forming a complete turnkey surveillance solution rather than standalone hardware.

Its networking arm focuses on industrial communication equipment and convenience-led network solutions, while its storage division works on network-attached storage built for power and versatility. Based in Waverley, Pretoria, ProDiS builds this offering through partnerships with leading international technology vendors and ongoing investment in its own technical team, aiming to deliver surveillance, networking and storage solutions for industrial and commercial clients.

Propshaft People & General Engineering has operated from Wonderboom South since April 1995, providing propshaft manufacturing, rebuilding and balancing for the motoring and industrial trade. The workshop custom builds propshafts to a vehicle's specifications, keeps exchange units in stock, and calibrates its two balancing machines at yearly intervals to keep the work accurate.

Beyond propshafts, the team rebuilds manual gearboxes and differentials, carries out suspension repairs and constant-velocity joint work, and runs a 50-point check across all makes and models while customers wait. It also stocks propshaft spares such as centre bearings, universal joints, gearbox and tube yokes, flanges and midship assemblies, sourcing parts it doesn't hold in stock to complete a repair.

PTA Linings and Filtration manufactures, imports and exports water filtration and storage products for domestic, commercial, agricultural and industrial use, with specialities spanning drinking water filtration, irrigation dripper-line and sprinkler filtration, borehole and farm water sanitation, and fish pond and fish farm filtration. Its manufacturing division produces custom linings, bladder tanks, self-supporting and glider bladder tanks, mesh tanks and replacement liners for existing reservoirs, as well as temporary emergency water storage.

The company's retail shop stocks a wide range of standard and custom filtration units alongside spares, pumps, fittings and accessories, and its home and garden section supplies pond and water-feature equipment for residential customers. Based in Derdepoort Smallholdings, Pretoria, it offers this combination of filtration specialities under one roof.
